title: Sources: Alice Huang and her partner pitched a Southeast Asia data center project to China-based investors in 2025, saying they had "no problem securing GPUs" (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: Sources: Alice Huang and her partner pitched a Southeast Asia data center project to China-based investors in 2025, saying they had “no problem securing GPUs” — Alice Huang boasted of having access to Nvidia GPUs and her connection to Alibaba in bid to secure investment for major data centre project
